library(tidyverse)

# Define the new cell label mapping

  "C3"  = "AC1",
  "C14" = "AC2",
  "C5"  = "Mic",
  "C16" = "Vas",
  "C1"  = "Oligo1",
  "C7"  = "Oligo2",
  "C10" = "Oligo3",
  "C8"  = "OPC",
  "C15" = "Neu-exi1",
  "C13" = "Neu-exi2",
  "C6"  = "Neu-exi3",
  "C4"  = "Neu-exi4",
  "C2"  = "Neu-exi5",
  "C12" = "Neu-exi6",
  "C9"  = "Neu-inh1",
  "C11" = "Neu-inh2"
)

# Load the CSV file into a data frame
#de_genes <- read_csv("path/to/de_genes.csv")  # Change the path to your actual file

# Add the new cell_label column based on the cluster column
de_genes <- de_genes %>%
  mutate(cell_label = cell_label_mapping[as.character(cluster)]) %>%
  replace_na(list(cell_label = "Unknown"))  # Assign "Unknown" if cluster is not mapped

# Save the updated data frame
#write_csv(de_genes, "path/to/de_genes_with_labels.csv")  # Change the path as needed

# Check the updated cell labels
table(de_genes$cell_label)

```{r}
deg_data_Mic
```

```{r}
# Assuming deg_data_Mic contains logFC values
logFC_threshold <- 0.54

# Select upregulated genes
upregulated_genes <- deg_data_Mic$gene[deg_data_Mic$logfoldchange > logFC_threshold]

# Select downregulated genes
downregulated_genes <- deg_data_Mic$gene[deg_data_Mic$logfoldchange < -logFC_threshold]
```

```{r}
# Convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs
upregulated_entrez <- bitr(upregulated_genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
downregulated_entrez <- bitr(downregulated_genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

# Extract only the Entrez IDs
upregulated_entrez <- upregulated_entrez$ENTREZID
downregulated_entrez <- downregulated_entrez$ENTREZID
```



```{r}
# GO enrichment for upregulated genes
ego_up <- enrichGO(gene = upregulated_entrez, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID",
                   ont = "MF", pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.05)

# GO enrichment for downregulated genes
ego_down <- enrichGO(gene = downregulated_entrez, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID",
                     ont = "MF", pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
```


```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(enrichplot)

barplot(ego_up, showCategory = 10, title = "GO Enrichment (Upregulated Genes)") + 
    theme_minimal()

# Barplot for GO Enrichment (Downregulated Genes)
barplot(ego_down, showCategory = 10, title = "GO Enrichment (Downregulated Genes)") + 
    theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# 加载必要的R包
library(clusterProfiler)
library(ggplot2)
library(enrichplot)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(rWikiPathways)

# 假设 upregulated_entrez 和 downregulated_entrez 已定义为上调和下调基因的 ENTREZ ID 向量

### 1. GO富集分析（上调基因）###

# Cellular Component (CC)
ego_up_cc <- enrichGO(gene = upregulated_entrez,
                      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                      keyType = "ENTREZID",
                      ont = "CC",
                      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                      qvalueCutoff = 0.05)

# Biological Process (BP)
ego_up_bp <- enrichGO(gene = upregulated_entrez,
                      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                      keyType = "ENTREZID",
                      ont = "BP",
                      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                      qvalueCutoff = 0.05)

# Molecular Function (MF)
ego_up_mf <- enrichGO(gene = upregulated_entrez,
                      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                      keyType = "ENTREZID",
                      ont = "MF",
                      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                      qvalueCutoff = 0.05)

### 2. GO富集分析（下调基因）###

# Cellular Component (CC)
ego_down_cc <- enrichGO(gene = downregulated_entrez,
                        OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                        keyType = "ENTREZID",
                        ont = "CC",
                        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                        pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                        qvalueCutoff = 0.05)

# Biological Process (BP)
ego_down_bp <- enrichGO(gene = downregulated_entrez,
                        OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                        keyType = "ENTREZID",
                        ont = "BP",
                        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                        pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                        qvalueCutoff = 0.05)

# Molecular Function (MF)
ego_down_mf <- enrichGO(gene = downregulated_entrez,
                        OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                        keyType = "ENTREZID",
                        ont = "MF",
                        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                        pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                        qvalueCutoff = 0.05)

### 3. 绘制GO富集条形图###

# 上调基因
barplot(ego_up_cc, showCategory = 10, title = "GO CC Enrichment (Upregulated Genes)") + theme_minimal()
barplot(ego_up_bp, showCategory = 10, title = "GO BP Enrichment (Upregulated Genes)") + theme_minimal()
barplot(ego_up_mf, showCategory = 10, title = "GO MF Enrichment (Upregulated Genes)") + theme_minimal()

# 下调基因
barplot(ego_down_cc, showCategory = 10, title = "GO CC Enrichment (Downregulated Genes)") + theme_minimal()
barplot(ego_down_bp, showCategory = 10, title = "GO BP Enrichment (Downregulated Genes)") + theme_minimal()
barplot(ego_down_mf, showCategory = 10, title = "GO MF Enrichment (Downregulated Genes)") + theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Define the folder path
folder_path <- "D:/ADscRNA/degene"

# List all CSV files in the folder
csv_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read and combine all CSV files
df_list <- lapply(csv_files, function(file) {
  df <- read_csv(file)
  df$cluster <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))  # Extract filename without .csv
  return(df)
})

# Combine all data frames
combined_df <- bind_rows(df_list)

# Save the combined DataFrame as a CSV file
output_path <- file.path(folder_path, "combined.csv")
write_csv(combined_df, output_path)

cat("Combined CSV saved to:", output_path, "\n")
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(UpSetR)

# Load the data
#csv_file <- "your_file.csv" # Replace with the correct file path
data <- ad.markers

# Filter data for upregulated and downregulated genes
upregulated <- data[data$avg_log2FC > 0.58 & data$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]
downregulated <- data[data$avg_log2FC < -0.58 & data$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]

# Count the number of upregulated and downregulated genes per cluster
up_counts <- table(upregulated$cluster)
down_counts <- table(downregulated$cluster)

# Merge counts into a data frame
counts <- data.frame(
  cluster = names(up_counts),
  Upregulated = as.numeric(up_counts),
  Downregulated = as.numeric(down_counts[names(up_counts)])
)
counts[is.na(counts)] <- 0 # Replace NAs with 0

# Create an UpSetR data frame
upset_data <- data.frame(
  cluster = counts$cluster,
  Upregulated = counts$Upregulated,
  Downregulated = counts$Downregulated
)

# Generate an UpSetR plot
upset_data$shared <- upset_data$Upregulated > 0 & upset_data$Downregulated > 0
upset_data$unique_up <- upset_data$Upregulated > 0 & upset_data$Downregulated == 0
upset_data$unique_down <- upset_data$Upregulated == 0 & upset_data$Downregulated > 0

# Add columns for visualization
upset_data$shared <- as.numeric(upset_data$shared)
upset_data$unique_up <- as.numeric(upset_data$unique_up)
upset_data$unique_down <- as.numeric(upset_data$unique_down)

# UpSet plot
# UpSet plot
upset_plot <- ggplot(upset_data, aes(x = reorder(cluster, -Upregulated))) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = Upregulated), stat = "identity", fill = "orange", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = -Downregulated), stat = "identity", fill = "blue", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(y = Upregulated + 5, label = Upregulated), size = 3, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(y = -Downregulated - 5, label = Downregulated), size = 3, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Clusters",
    y = "Gene Count",
    title = "Upregulated and Downregulated Gene Counts by Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Show the plot
print(upset_plot)

```

```{r}
# Filter data for upregulated and downregulated genes
upregulated <- data %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0.58, p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(regulation = "Upregulated")

downregulated <- data %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC < -0.58, p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(regulation = "Downregulated")

# Combine upregulated and downregulated data
combined_data <- bind_rows(upregulated, downregulated)

# Count genes per cluster and regulation type
cluster_counts <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(cluster, regulation) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Create a barplot with UpSet-like elements
ggplot(cluster_counts, aes(x = reorder(cluster, -count), y = count, fill = regulation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "orange", "Downregulated" = "blue")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Gene Counts by Cluster and Regulation",
       x = "Cluster",
       y = "Gene Count") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
